records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: go down [to the] house of [the] king of Judah, and you will speak there the word this,

en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: "Go down to the palace where the king of Judah lives, and give this message there.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: "Hãy đi xuống nhà vua Giu-đa, và tại đó hãy nói lời này,
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: "Con hãy đi xuống cung vua Giu-đa và nói sứ điệp này tại đó.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: "Con hãy đi xuống cung điện nơi vua Giu-đa ở, và truyền sứ điệp này tại đó.

decisions.choice: God speaks to Jeremiah, sending him with a message to the king; the message runs from verse 2 to verse 5
decisions.reason: Verses 1-5 are a short prose sermon like 7:1-15 and 17:19-27. A collection of oracles about the kings of Judah follows from verse 6: about the palace (6-9), Shallum (10-12), Jehoiakim (13-19), Jerusalem (20-23) and Coniah (24-30). It continues the word to the royal house begun in 21:11-14, which also calls the king to do justice.

decisions.choice: go down: from the temple, which stood on higher ground, to the palace below it
decisions.reason: The royal palace stood just south of the temple and lower on the same hill, so a prophet coming from the temple court went down to it (compare 26:10 and 36:12, where officials go up from the palace to the temple and down again).

decisions.choice: the palace (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "The house of the king" is the royal palace; Balanced and Readable say so. Literal keeps "house", which in verse 5 and later in the chapter also hints at the royal family.

decisions.choice: Thus says the LORD: (L); The LORD says this: (B); This is what the LORD says: (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula in Isaiah and Jeremiah. Because God's instruction to Jeremiah is prose and contains the words he is to say, it is quoted as prose speech, as in 19:1-13.

decisions.choice: el palacio
decisions.reason: The king's "house" is his palace (meaning decision m2), as the English Balanced and Readable say; Literal keeps "casa".

decisions.choice: jumba la mfalme
decisions.reason: "The house of the king" is the palace; Balanced and Readable say "jumba", as the English says "palace".

decisions.choice: "au palais" (B, R); "à la maison du roi" (L)
alternatives: à la maison du roi at every level
decisions.reason: As the English: "the house of the king" is the royal palace, which Balanced and Readable say; Literal keeps "maison", which in verse 5 also hints at the royal family.

source.text: וְאָֽמַרְתָּ֙ שְׁמַ֣ע דְּבַר־יְהוָ֔ה מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַיֹּשֵׁ֖ב עַל־כִּסֵּ֣א דָוִ֑ד אַתָּ֤ה וַעֲבָדֶ֨יךָ֙ וְעַמְּךָ֔ הַבָּאִ֖ים בַּשְּׁעָרִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and you will say: Hear [the] word of Yahweh, king of Judah, the [one] sitting on [the] throne of David, you and your servants and your people, the [ones] entering through the gates these.

en.L: and say, 'Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, king of Judah, who sits on the throne of David, you and your servants and your people who enter through these gates.
en.B: Say: 'Hear the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, king of Judah, you who sit on David's throne, you and your officials and your people who come in through these gates.
en.R: Say: 'King of Judah, you who rule from David's throne, listen to this message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Listen, you and your officials and all your people who come in through these gates.

es.L: y di: “Oye la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, rey de Judá, que te sientas sobre el trono de David, tú y tus siervos y tu pueblo que entran por estas puertas.
es.B: Di: “Escucha la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, rey de Judá, tú que te sientas en el trono de David, tú, tus funcionarios y tu pueblo que entran por estas puertas.
es.R: Di: “Rey de Judá, tú que gobiernas desde el trono de David, escucha este mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Escucha tú, y que escuchen tus funcionarios y todo tu pueblo que entran por estas puertas.

fr.L: et dis : “Écoute la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, roi de Juda, qui sièges sur le trône de David, toi, tes serviteurs et ton peuple, qui entrez par ces portes.
fr.B: Dis : “Écoute la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, roi de Juda, toi qui sièges sur le trône de David, toi, tes hauts fonctionnaires et ton peuple, vous qui entrez par ces portes.
fr.R: Dis : “Roi de Juda, toi qui règnes sur le trône de David, écoute ce message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Écoutez-le, toi, tes hauts fonctionnaires et tout ton peuple qui entrez par ces portes.

sw.L: useme, 'Sikia neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ee mfalme wa Yuda, uketiye juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, wewe na watumishi wako na watu wako wanaoingia kwa malango haya.
sw.B: Useme: 'Sikiliza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ee mfalme wa Yuda, wewe uketiye juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, wewe na maafisa wako na watu wako wanaoingia kwa malango haya.
sw.R: Useme: 'Ee mfalme wa Yuda, wewe unayetawala kutoka kiti cha enzi cha Daudi, sikiliza ujumbe huu kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Sikilizeni, wewe na maafisa wako na watu wako wote wanaoingia kwa malango haya.

vi.L: và nói: 'Hỡi vua Giu-đa, người ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít, hãy nghe lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua cùng các đầy tớ vua và dân của vua, là những người đi vào qua các cổng này.
vi.B: Hãy nói: 'Hỡi vua Giu-đa, là người ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít, hãy nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vua cùng các quần thần và dân chúng của vua, là những người ra vào các cổng này.
vi.R: Hãy nói: 'Hỡi vua Giu-đa, là người cai trị trên ngai của Đa-vít, hãy nghe sứ điệp này từ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua, các quan chức và toàn dân của vua, là những người ra vào các cổng này, hãy lắng nghe.

decisions.choice: who sits on the throne of David: the reigning king, as heir of the promise to David
decisions.reason: The king is named by his place in David's line, which recalls God's promise that David's house and throne would last (2 Samuel 7:16). The whole chapter turns on whether David's heirs will keep that throne (verses 4 and 30).

decisions.choice: your servants: the king's officials at court
decisions.reason: Here the word means the men who served the king in government, not slaves.

decisions.choice: these gates: the gates of the palace
decisions.reason: The king, his court and the people who had business there came and went through the palace gates. Verse 4 names them "the gates of this house".

decisions.choice: officials (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As Isaiah and the earlier books do for a king's court, Literal keeps "servants" and Balanced and Readable say "officials".

decisions.choice: Oye / Escucha (singular)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew command is singular, spoken to the king, with his officials and people named after him; Spanish keeps the singular "tú". The commands of verse 3 are plural.

decisions.choice: Sikia (singular)
decisions.reason: The king is addressed with the singular "sikia"; Swahili's singular and plural "you" follow the Hebrew, so Readable turns to the plural "Sikilizeni" when it names the officials and people too.

decisions.choice: "tes hauts fonctionnaires" (B, R); "tes serviteurs" (L)
decisions.reason: As the Kings note sets for a king's court: Literal keeps "serviteurs", Balanced and Readable say what they were.

decisions.choice: the prophet's message calls the king "vua"
decisions.reason: The message is given through Jeremiah, and in Kings the prophet speaks to the king as "vua"; God's own direct address in the oracles that follow (verses 6-7, 24-26) is "ngươi".

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עֲשׂ֤וּ מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּצְדָקָ֔ה וְהַצִּ֥ילוּ גָז֖וּל מִיַּ֣ד עָשׁ֑וֹק וְגֵר֩ יָת֨וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֤ה אַל־תֹּנוּ֙ אַל־תַּחְמֹ֔סוּ וְדָ֣ם נָקִ֔י אַֽל־תִּשְׁפְּכ֖וּ בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: do justice and righteousness, and deliver [the] robbed from [the] hand of [the] oppressor, and [the] sojourner, [the] fatherless and [the] widow do not wrong, do not treat violently, and blood innocent do not shed in the place this.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Do justice and righteousness, and rescue the robbed from the hand of the oppressor. Do not wrong the sojourner, the fatherless, or the widow; do no violence; and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Practice justice and righteousness. Rescue anyone who has been robbed from the power of the oppressor. Do not mistreat the outsider, the orphan or the widow, do not use violence against them, and do not shed innocent blood in this place.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: Do what is fair and right. Rescue people who have been robbed from those who oppress them. Do not mistreat or harm strangers, orphans or widows, and do not kill innocent people in this place.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} derecho y justicia, y {{plural_you:libren|librad}} al despojado de mano del opresor. No {{plural_you:opriman|oprimáis}} al extranjero, al huérfano ni a la viuda, no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} violencia, y no {{plural_you:derramen|derraméis}} sangre inocente en este lugar.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: {{plural_you:Practiquen|Practicad}} el derecho y la justicia. {{plural_you:Libren|Librad}} del poder del opresor a todo el que haya sido despojado. No {{plural_you:maltraten|maltratéis}} al extranjero, al huérfano ni a la viuda, no {{plural_you:usen|uséis}} la violencia contra ellos, y no {{plural_you:derramen|derraméis}} sangre inocente en este lugar.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} lo que es justo y correcto. {{plural_you:Salven|Salvad}} a los que han sido robados de los que los oprimen. No {{plural_you:maltraten|maltratéis}} ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a los extranjeros, a los huérfanos ni a las viudas, y no {{plural_you:maten|matéis}} a gente inocente en este lugar.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Pratiquez le droit et la justice, et délivrez celui qu’on dépouille de la main de l’oppresseur. Ne maltraitez pas l’immigré, l’orphelin et la veuve ; ne faites pas de violence ; et ne versez pas le sang innocent en ce lieu.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Pratiquez le droit et la justice. Délivrez celui qu’on a dépouillé du pouvoir de l’oppresseur. Ne maltraitez pas l’étranger qui vit parmi vous, l’orphelin et la veuve, n’usez pas de violence contre eux, et ne versez pas le sang innocent en ce lieu.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Faites ce qui est juste et honnête. Sauvez ceux qu’on a volés de ceux qui les oppriment. Ne maltraitez pas et ne brutalisez pas les étrangers, les orphelins et les veuves, et ne tuez pas des innocents en ce lieu.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Fanyeni hukumu na haki, mkamwokoe aliyenyang'anywa kutoka mkononi mwa mdhalimu. Msimdhulumu mgeni, wala yatima, wala mjane; msitende jeuri; wala msimwage damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Tendeni haki na uadilifu. Mwokoeni yeyote aliyenyang'anywa kutoka katika nguvu za mdhalimu. Msimtendee vibaya mgeni, yatima wala mjane, msiwafanyie jeuri, wala msimwage damu isiyo na hatia mahali hapa.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Tendeni yaliyo ya haki na mema. Waokoeni watu walionyang'anywa mali zao kutoka kwa wale wanaowaonea. Msiwatendee vibaya wala msiwadhuru wageni, yatima wala wajane, wala msiwaue watu wasio na hatia mahali hapa.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Hãy thi hành công lý và sự công chính, hãy giải cứu người bị cướp khỏi tay kẻ áp bức. Đừng bạc đãi khách lạ, trẻ mồ côi và người góa bụa; đừng dùng bạo lực; và đừng làm đổ máu vô tội tại nơi này.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Hãy thực thi công lý và sự công chính. Hãy giải cứu người bị cướp bóc khỏi quyền lực kẻ áp bức. Đừng ngược đãi người ngoại kiều, trẻ mồ côi hay người góa bụa, đừng dùng bạo lực với họ, và đừng làm đổ máu vô tội tại nơi này.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Hãy làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng. Hãy cứu những người bị cướp khỏi tay kẻ áp bức họ. Đừng ngược đãi hay làm hại người ngoại quốc, trẻ mồ côi hay người góa bụa, và đừng giết người vô tội tại nơi này.

decisions.choice: do justice and righteousness: rule and act fairly, giving every person what is right
decisions.reason: The two words are often paired (verse 15; 2 Samuel 8:15; Isaiah 9:6) for fair judgment together with right dealing. Together they describe the king's first duty: to see that the weak get their rights.

decisions.choice: the sojourner, the fatherless and the widow: people with no family or land to protect them
decisions.reason: A sojourner was a person from elsewhere living among Israel without the rights of a landholder; orphans and widows had lost the men who would defend them in court. The Law names these three together as those God himself protects (Deuteronomy 10:18; 24:17; Exodus 22:20-23), and Jeremiah's temple sermon repeats the same charge (7:6).

decisions.choice: shed innocent blood: put innocent people to death
decisions.reason: The phrase covers murder and also judicial killing of the innocent. Jehoiakim is charged with it in verse 17 (compare 26:20-23, the killing of the prophet Uriah).

decisions.choice: what is fair and right (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable puts the pair "justice and righteousness" in everyday words; the same pair returns in verse 15.

decisions.choice: outsider (Balanced); strangers (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this word (sojourner, outsider, stranger) since Leviticus; "foreigner" is kept for another Hebrew word.

decisions.choice: el derecho y la justicia (Literal, Balanced)
decisions.reason: The pair *mishpat* and *tsedaqah* (meaning decision m1) is "derecho" and "justicia" at Literal and Balanced, as in Psalms (Literal) and throughout Isaiah and Jeremiah; Readable says "lo que es justo y correcto".

decisions.choice: hukumu na haki (L); haki na uadilifu (B); yaliyo ya haki (R)
decisions.reason: *Mishpat* is "hukumu" at Literal and "haki" at Balanced and Readable, as the terms note sets; paired with *tsedaqah*, Balanced says "haki na uadilifu", as Isaiah (1:21; 33:5) and 9:23; Readable says "yaliyo ya haki na mema".

decisions.choice: "le droit et la justice" (L, B); "ce qui est juste et honnête" (R)
decisions.reason: The pair mishpat and tsedaqah as the terms note sets it; Readable says it in everyday words, as the English does, and verse 15 uses the same wording.

decisions.choice: "l'immigré" (L); "l'étranger qui vit parmi vous" (B); "les étrangers" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording of Psalm 146:9 in French for the resident outsider (ger).

decisions.choice: "công lý và sự công chính" (L, B); "khách lạ" (L), "người ngoại kiều" (B), "người ngoại quốc" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words for justice and righteousness; the sojourner is named at each level as the English does it.

source.text: כִּ֤י אִם־עָשׂוֹ֙ תַּֽעֲשׂ֔וּ אֶת־הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה וּבָ֣אוּ בְשַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֣יִת הַזֶּ֡ה מְלָכִים֩ יֹשְׁבִ֨ים לְדָוִ֜ד עַל־כִּסְא֗וֹ רֹֽכְבִים֙ בָּרֶ֣כֶב וּבַסּוּסִ֔ים ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְעַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For if doing you do the word this, then will enter through [the] gates of the house this kings sitting for David on his throne, riding in chariot and on horses, he and his servants and his people.

en.L: For if you indeed do this word, then there will enter through the gates of this house kings who sit for David on his throne, riding in chariots and on horses, he and his servants and his people.
en.B: For if you are careful to do what this word commands, then kings who sit on David's throne will come in through the gates of this palace, riding in chariots and on horses, each with his officials and his people.
en.R: If you really obey this command, kings from David's family will go on ruling from his throne. They will ride in chariots and on horses through the gates of this palace, together with their officials and their people.

es.L: Porque si de veras {{plural_you:hacen|hacéis}} esta palabra, entonces entrarán por las puertas de esta casa reyes que se sientan por David sobre su trono, montados en carros y en caballos, él y sus siervos y su pueblo.
es.B: Porque si {{plural_you:cumplen|cumplís}} fielmente lo que manda esta palabra, entonces reyes que se sienten en el trono de David entrarán por las puertas de este palacio, montados en carros y a caballo, cada uno con sus funcionarios y su pueblo.
es.R: Si de verdad {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} este mandato, seguirá habiendo reyes de la familia de David que gobiernen desde su trono. Entrarán por las puertas de este palacio en carros y a caballo, junto con sus funcionarios y su pueblo.

fr.L: Car si vous pratiquez vraiment cette parole, alors entreront par les portes de cette maison des rois siégeant pour David sur son trône, montés sur des chars et sur des chevaux, lui, ses serviteurs et son peuple.
fr.B: Car si vous prenez soin de faire ce que commande cette parole, alors des rois siégeant sur le trône de David entreront par les portes de ce palais, montés sur des chars et sur des chevaux, chacun avec ses hauts fonctionnaires et son peuple.
fr.R: Si vous obéissez vraiment à cet ordre, des rois de la famille de David continueront à régner sur son trône. Ils passeront les portes de ce palais sur des chars et sur des chevaux, avec leurs hauts fonctionnaires et leur peuple.

sw.L: Kwa maana mkilitenda kweli neno hili, ndipo wataingia kwa malango ya nyumba hii wafalme waketio kwa ajili ya Daudi juu ya kiti chake cha enzi, wakipanda magari ya vita na farasi, yeye na watumishi wake na watu wake.
sw.B: Kwa maana mkiwa waangalifu kutenda yale neno hili linaloamuru, ndipo wafalme waketio juu ya kiti cha enzi cha Daudi wataingia kwa malango ya jumba hili, wakipanda magari ya vita na farasi, kila mmoja pamoja na maafisa wake na watu wake.
sw.R: Mkiitii kweli amri hii, wafalme wa ukoo wa Daudi wataendelea kutawala kutoka kiti chake cha enzi. Watapita kwa malango ya jumba hili wakipanda magari ya vita na farasi, pamoja na maafisa wao na watu wao.

vi.L: Vì nếu các ngươi thật sự làm theo lời này, thì sẽ có các vua ngồi trên ngai thay cho Đa-vít, đi xe ngựa và cưỡi ngựa, vào qua các cổng của nhà này, vua cùng các đầy tớ và dân của vua.
vi.B: Vì nếu các ngươi cẩn thận làm đúng như lời này truyền, thì các vua ngồi trên ngai Đa-vít sẽ vào qua các cổng cung điện này, đi xe ngựa và cưỡi ngựa, mỗi vua cùng quần thần và dân chúng mình.
vi.R: Nếu các ngươi thật sự vâng theo mệnh lệnh này, thì các vua thuộc dòng dõi Đa-vít sẽ tiếp tục cai trị trên ngai của ông. Họ sẽ đi xe ngựa và cưỡi ngựa qua các cổng cung điện này, cùng với các quan chức và dân chúng của mình.

decisions.choice: if you indeed do: the doubled verb stresses real, careful obedience
decisions.reason: Hebrew repeats the verb to make it emphatic: doing it in earnest, not in part.

decisions.choice: kings sitting for David on his throne: David's heirs, reigning in his place one after another
decisions.reason: "For David" means as David's successors. The promise is that the dynasty will go on, as in 17:25, where the same picture of kings riding through the gates is given as a reward for keeping the sabbath.

decisions.choice: his servants: the plural read aloud
decisions.reason: The written consonants could be read as "his servant"; the form read aloud is "his servants", which matches verse 2. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: kings from David's family will go on ruling
decisions.reason: Readable spells out that the promise is for David's line to continue.

source.text: וְאִם֙ לֹ֣א תִשְׁמְע֔וּ אֶת־הַדְּבָרִ֖ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה בִּ֤י נִשְׁבַּ֨עְתִּי֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־לְחָרְבָּ֥ה יִֽהְיֶ֖ה הַבַּ֥יִת הַזֶּֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And if not you will hear the words these, by myself I swear, declares Yahweh, that a ruin will become the house this.

en.L: But if you will not hear these words, by {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}} I swear, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that this house will become a ruin.'"
en.B: But if you will not listen to these words, I swear by {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that this palace will become a ruin.'"
en.R: But if you will not obey these words, I swear by {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, that this palace will be left in ruins.'"

es.L: Pero si no {{plural_you:oyen|oís}} estas palabras, por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo he jurado, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que esta casa se convertirá en ruina”».
es.B: Pero si no {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} estas palabras, juro por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que este palacio quedará en ruinas”».
es.R: Pero si no {{plural_you:obedecen|obedecéis}} estas palabras, juro por {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} mismo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que este palacio quedará hecho ruinas”».

fr.L: Mais si vous n’écoutez pas ces paroles, je le jure par {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, cette maison deviendra une ruine.” »
fr.B: Mais si vous n’écoutez pas ces paroles, je le jure par {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ce palais deviendra une ruine.” »
fr.R: Mais si vous n’obéissez pas à ces paroles, je le jure par {{deity_pronoun:moi-même|Moi-même}}, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, ce palais sera réduit en ruines.” »

sw.L: Lakini msipoyasikia maneno haya, nimeapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba nyumba hii itakuwa magofu.'"
sw.B: Lakini msipoyasikiliza maneno haya, naapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba jumba hili litakuwa magofu.'"
sw.R: Lakini msipoyatii maneno haya, naapa kwa nafsi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba jumba hili litaachwa likiwa magofu.'"

vi.L: Nhưng nếu các ngươi không nghe những lời này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, rằng nhà này sẽ thành một nơi đổ nát.'"
vi.B: Nhưng nếu các ngươi không nghe những lời này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, cung điện này sẽ thành đống đổ nát.'"
vi.R: Nhưng nếu các ngươi không vâng theo những lời này, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} lấy chính mình {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà thề, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, cung điện này sẽ bị bỏ hoang đổ nát.'"

decisions.choice: by myself I swear: God binds himself by an oath on his own life and name
decisions.reason: There is no one greater for God to swear by, so he swears by himself (Genesis 22:16; Isaiah 45:23). The oath makes the warning certain.

decisions.choice: this house: the palace, with the royal family it stands for
decisions.reason: The house that becomes a ruin is the palace building (verse 6), but "house" also means a dynasty (2 Samuel 7:11-16), and the chapter goes on to say that the line itself will lose the throne (verse 30).

decisions.choice: declares the LORD (L, B); says the LORD (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this formula in Isaiah and Jeremiah. The quotation that began in verse 1 closes here.

decisions.choice: "Ta lấy chính mình Ta mà thề"
decisions.reason: The oath on God's own self, worded the same at each level; "mình Ta" takes the span for the English "Myself".

source.text: כִּֽי־כֹ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה עַל־בֵּית֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה גִּלְעָ֥ד אַתָּ֛ה לִ֖י רֹ֣אשׁ הַלְּבָנ֑וֹן אִם־לֹ֤א אֲשִֽׁיתְךָ֙ מִדְבָּ֔ר עָרִ֖ים לֹ֥א נוֹשָֽׁבוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh concerning [the] house of [the] king of Judah: Gilead [are] you to me, [the] head of the Lebanon; if not I will make you a wilderness, cities not inhabited.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning the house of the king of Judah: \q You [are] Gilead to {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, the summit of Lebanon; \q yet surely I will make you a wilderness, \q cities not inhabited.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about the palace of the king of Judah: \q To {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you are like Gilead, like the heights of Lebanon, \q but I will surely make you a wilderness, \q like towns where no one lives.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about the palace of the king of Judah: \q To {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} you are as fine as the forests of Gilead, as splendid as the top of the Lebanon mountains. \q But I will turn you into a desert, \q like towns where no one lives.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de la casa del rey de Judá: \q Galaad [eres] tú para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, cumbre del Líbano; \q pero ciertamente te convertiré en desierto, \q ciudades no habitadas.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca del palacio del rey de Judá: \q Para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} eres como Galaad, como las alturas del Líbano, \q pero de cierto te convertiré en un desierto, \q como ciudades donde nadie vive.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca del palacio del rey de Judá: \q Para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} eres tan hermoso como los bosques de Galaad, tan espléndido como la cumbre de los montes del Líbano. \q Pero te convertiré en un desierto, \q como ciudades donde no vive nadie.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de la maison du roi de Juda : \q Tu [es] pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} Galaad, le sommet du Liban ; \q pourtant, je ferai de toi un désert, \q des villes inhabitées.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet du palais du roi de Juda : \q Tu es pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} comme Galaad, comme les hauteurs du Liban, \q mais je ferai de toi un désert, je le jure, \q comme des villes où personne n’habite.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet du palais du roi de Juda : \q Pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, tu es aussi beau que les forêts de Galaad, aussi magnifique que le sommet des montagnes du Liban. \q Mais je vais faire de toi un désert, \q comme des villes où personne ne vit.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu nyumba ya mfalme wa Yuda: \q Wewe [u] Gileadi kwangu, kilele cha Lebanoni; \q lakini hakika nitakufanya kuwa jangwa, \q miji isiyokaliwa na watu.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu jumba la mfalme wa Yuda: \q Kwangu wewe ni kama Gileadi, kama vilele vya Lebanoni, \q lakini hakika nitakufanya kuwa nyika, \q kama miji isiyo na mtu anayeishi ndani yake.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu jumba la mfalme wa Yuda: \q Kwangu wewe ni mzuri kama misitu ya Gileadi, na wa fahari kama vilele vya milima ya Lebanoni. \q Lakini nitakugeuza kuwa jangwa, \q kama miji isiyo na mtu anayeishi ndani yake.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về nhà vua Giu-đa: \q Đối với Ta, ngươi [là] Ga-la-át, là đỉnh núi Li-ban; \q nhưng chắc chắn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho ngươi thành hoang mạc, \q thành những thành không người ở.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về cung điện vua Giu-đa: \q Đối với Ta, ngươi như Ga-la-át, như các đỉnh cao Li-ban, \q nhưng chắc chắn {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ biến ngươi thành hoang mạc, \q như những thành không còn ai ở.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về cung điện của vua Giu-đa: \q Đối với Ta, ngươi đẹp như rừng Ga-la-át, lộng lẫy như đỉnh núi Li-ban. \q Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ biến ngươi thành sa mạc, \q như những thành không còn ai ở.

decisions.choice: Gilead, the summit of Lebanon: places famous for their forests, here a picture of the cedar-built palace
decisions.reason: Gilead east of the Jordan and the Lebanon mountains in the north were known for tall trees, and Lebanon above all for cedar. Solomon's great hall built of cedar was called "the House of the Forest of Lebanon" (1 Kings 7:2). The palace is as grand and green as those forests, and as easily felled (verse 7).

decisions.choice: if not I will make you: a form of oath, meaning "I will surely make you"
decisions.reason: The words "if I do not ..." stand for an oath with its curse left unspoken; they mean the opposite of what they seem to say: "I will certainly do it".

decisions.choice: you: the palace, and the royal house it stands for
decisions.reason: God speaks to the palace as a person. The "cities" that are not inhabited compare its fate to towns left empty after war (4:7).

decisions.choice: like Gilead, like the peak (Balanced); as fine as the forests of Gilead (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the names side by side as a picture; Balanced adds "like" and Readable says what the picture compares.

decisions.choice: the palace is "ngươi" at every level
decisions.reason: The house under judgment is addressed with the "ngươi" the terms note gives for cities and kings under God's sentence; "con" is kept for tender address to the prophet and the king elsewhere.

source.text: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֥י עָלֶ֛יךָ מַשְׁחִתִ֖ים אִ֣ישׁ וְכֵלָ֑יו וְכָֽרְתוּ֙ מִבְחַ֣ר אֲרָזֶ֔יךָ וְהִפִּ֖ילוּ עַל־הָאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will consecrate against you destroyers, a man and his weapons, and they will cut down [the] choicest of your cedars and will cast [them] on the fire.

en.L: And I will consecrate destroyers against you, each with his weapons, \q and they will cut down the choicest of your cedars \q and throw [them] into the fire.
en.B: I will appoint destroyers against you, each with his weapons. \q They will cut down your finest cedars \q and throw them into the fire.
en.R: I will send destroyers against you, each one armed. \q They will cut down your finest cedar beams \q and throw them into the fire.

es.L: Y consagraré contra ti destructores, cada uno con sus armas, \q y cortarán lo mejor de tus cedros \q y [los] echarán al fuego.
es.B: Designaré contra ti destructores, cada uno con sus armas. \q Cortarán tus cedros más finos \q y los echarán al fuego.
es.R: Enviaré contra ti destructores, cada uno con sus armas. \q Cortarán tus mejores vigas de cedro \q y las echarán al fuego.

fr.L: Et je consacrerai contre toi des destructeurs, chacun avec ses armes, \q et ils couperont l’élite de tes cèdres \q et [les] jetteront au feu.
fr.B: Je désignerai contre toi des destructeurs, chacun avec ses armes. \q Ils abattront tes plus beaux cèdres \q et les jetteront au feu.
fr.R: J’enverrai contre toi des destructeurs, chacun avec ses armes. \q Ils abattront tes plus belles poutres de cèdre \q et les jetteront au feu.

sw.L: Nami nitaweka wakfu waharibu juu yako, kila mmoja na silaha zake, \q nao wataikata mierezi yako iliyo bora \q na kuitupa motoni.
sw.B: Nitawateua waharibu dhidi yako, kila mmoja na silaha zake. \q Wataikata mierezi yako iliyo bora kabisa \q na kuitupa motoni.
sw.R: Nitatuma waharibu dhidi yako, kila mmoja akiwa na silaha. \q Watazikata boriti zako bora za mierezi \q na kuzitupa motoni.

vi.L: Ta sẽ biệt riêng những kẻ hủy diệt nghịch cùng ngươi, mỗi người với khí giới mình; \q chúng sẽ đốn những cây bá hương tốt nhất của ngươi \q và quăng [chúng] vào lửa.
vi.B: Ta sẽ chỉ định những kẻ hủy diệt nghịch cùng ngươi, mỗi người cầm khí giới mình. \q Chúng sẽ đốn những cây bá hương tốt nhất của ngươi \q và ném vào lửa.
vi.R: Ta sẽ sai những kẻ hủy diệt đến đánh ngươi, mỗi người đều mang vũ khí. \q Chúng sẽ chặt những cây xà bằng gỗ bá hương tốt nhất của ngươi \q và ném chúng vào lửa.

decisions.choice: consecrate: set apart and make ready for a holy war
decisions.reason: The verb means to make holy; used of soldiers it means to prepare them for a war fought at God's command (6:4; 51:27-28; Joel 4:9). God is the one who musters the enemy against his own city.

decisions.choice: your choicest cedars: the cedar pillars and beams of the palace
decisions.reason: The picture of the forest from verse 6 continues: the cedars cut down are the palace timbers (1 Kings 7:2-3). Jerusalem's palace was burned in 587 BC (39:8; 52:13).

decisions.choice: appoint (Balanced); send (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the verb rather than "consecrate", which Literal keeps.

decisions.choice: cedar beams
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the cedars are the timbers of the building.

source.text: וְעָֽבְרוּ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים עַ֖ל הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וְאָֽמְרוּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ אֶל־רֵעֵ֔הוּ עַל־מֶ֨ה עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ כָּ֔כָה לָעִ֥יר הַגְּדוֹלָ֖ה הַזֹּֽאת׃

records.literal_gloss: And will pass many nations by the city this, and they will say each to his neighbor: For what has done Yahweh thus to the city great this?

en.L: And many nations will pass by this city, and they will say each to his neighbor, "Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} done thus to this great city?"
en.B: People of many nations will pass by this city and say to one another, "Why has {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} treated this great city like this?"
en.R: People from many nations will walk past this city. They will ask one another, "Why did {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} do this to such a great city?"

es.L: Y muchas naciones pasarán junto a esta ciudad, y dirán cada uno a su prójimo: «¿Por qué ha hecho así {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} con esta gran ciudad?».
es.B: Gente de muchas naciones pasará junto a esta ciudad y se dirán unos a otros: «¿Por qué {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} trató así a esta gran ciudad?».
es.R: Gente de muchas naciones pasará por esta ciudad. Se preguntarán unos a otros: «¿Por qué {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le hizo esto a una ciudad tan grande?».

fr.L: Et beaucoup de nations passeront près de cette ville, et elles diront chacune à son prochain : « Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il agi ainsi envers cette grande ville ? »
fr.B: Des gens de nombreuses nations passeront près de cette ville et se diront les uns aux autres : « Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il traité ainsi cette grande ville ? »
fr.R: Des gens de beaucoup de nations passeront à côté de cette ville. Ils se demanderont les uns aux autres : « Pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a-t-il fait cela à une ville si importante ? »

sw.L: Na mataifa mengi watapita karibu na mji huu, nao watasemezana kila mmoja na jirani yake, "Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameutendea mji huu mkubwa hivi?"
sw.B: Watu wa mataifa mengi watapita karibu na mji huu na kuulizana, "Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ameutendea mji huu mkubwa namna hii?"
sw.R: Watu kutoka mataifa mengi watapita karibu na mji huu. Wataulizana, "Kwa nini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliutendea mji mkubwa kama huu jambo hili?"

vi.L: Nhiều dân tộc sẽ đi ngang qua thành này, và mỗi người sẽ nói với người lân cận mình: "Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã làm như thế cho thành lớn này?"
vi.B: Người của nhiều dân tộc sẽ đi ngang qua thành này và hỏi nhau: "Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại đối xử với thành lớn này như vậy?"
vi.R: Người từ nhiều dân tộc sẽ đi ngang qua thành này. Họ sẽ hỏi nhau: "Tại sao {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} lại làm như thế với một thành lớn như vậy?"

decisions.choice: the question of the passing nations: the curse of the covenant foretold in the Law and at the temple's dedication
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 29:23-25 and 1 Kings 9:8-9 give the same question and answer: people seeing the ruined land or house ask why the LORD did this, and are told that Israel forsook his covenant.

decisions.choice: people of many nations
decisions.reason: "Nations" here means people from those nations who travel past; Balanced and Readable say so.

source.text: וְאָ֣מְר֔וּ עַ֚ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָֽזְב֔וּ אֶת־בְּרִ֥ית יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיִּֽשְׁתַּחֲו֛וּ לֵאלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִ֖ים וַיַּעַבְדֽוּם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they will say: Because they forsook [the] covenant of Yahweh their God and they bowed down to other gods and served them.

en.L: And they will say, "Because they forsook the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and bowed down to other gods and served them."
en.B: And the answer will be, "Because they abandoned the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and worshiped other gods and served them."
en.R: And others will answer, "It is because the people abandoned the covenant they had with {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God. They worshiped other gods and served them."

es.L: Y dirán: «Porque abandonaron el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y se postraron ante otros dioses y les sirvieron».
es.B: Y la respuesta será: «Porque abandonaron el pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y adoraron a otros dioses y les sirvieron».
es.R: Y otros responderán: «Es porque el pueblo abandonó el pacto que tenía con {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} su Dios. Adoraron a otros dioses y les sirvieron».

fr.L: Et l’on dira : « Parce qu’ils ont abandonné l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et qu’ils se sont prosternés devant d’autres dieux et les ont servis. »
fr.B: Et on leur répondra : « Parce qu’ils ont abandonné l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} leur Dieu, qu’ils ont adoré d’autres dieux et les ont servis. »
fr.R: Et d’autres répondront : « C’est parce que le peuple a abandonné l’alliance qu’il avait avec {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} son Dieu. Ils ont adoré d’autres dieux et ils les ont servis. »

sw.L: Nao watasema, "Kwa sababu waliliacha agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakaisujudia miungu mingine na kuitumikia."
sw.B: Na jibu litakuwa, "Kwa sababu waliliacha agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakaiabudu miungu mingine na kuitumikia."
sw.R: Na wengine watajibu, "Ni kwa sababu watu waliliacha agano walilokuwa nalo na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao. Waliiabudu miungu mingine na kuitumikia."

vi.L: Người ta sẽ trả lời: "Vì chúng đã lìa bỏ giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng, mà quỳ lạy các thần khác và phục vụ các thần ấy."
vi.B: Và người ta sẽ đáp: "Vì chúng đã chối bỏ giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của chúng, mà thờ lạy và phục vụ các thần khác."
vi.R: Những người khác sẽ trả lời: "Vì dân ở đây đã chối bỏ giao ước họ đã lập với {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ. Họ đã thờ lạy các thần khác và phục vụ các thần ấy."

decisions.choice: they forsook the covenant: the ruin comes from breaking the covenant, not from the LORD's weakness
decisions.reason: The nations' answer says that the city fell because its people left the LORD for other gods, the first of the covenant's commands (Exodus 20:3-5), not because their God could not protect it.

decisions.choice: bowed down: worshiped
decisions.reason: As in 7:2, the verb of bowing low names the act of worship.

decisions.choice: the answer will be (Balanced); others will answer (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they will say"; the speakers answer the question of verse 8, and Balanced and Readable make that plain.

source.text: אַל־תִּבְכּ֣וּ לְמֵ֔ת וְאַל־תָּנֻ֖דוּ ל֑וֹ בְּכ֤וּ בָכוֹ֙ לַֽהֹלֵ֔ךְ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָשׁוּב֙ ע֔וֹד וְרָאָ֖ה אֶת־אֶ֥רֶץ מוֹלַדְתּֽוֹ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Do not weep for [the] dead and do not show grief for him; weep weeping for [the one] going, for not he will return again and see [the] land of his kindred.

en.L: Do not weep for the dead, \q and do not grieve for him; \q weep bitterly for the one who goes away, \q for he will not return again \q and see the land of his birth.
en.B: Do not weep for the one who is dead; \q do not mourn for him. \q Weep and keep weeping for the one who is going away, \q because he will never return \q or see his homeland again.
en.R: Do not cry for the king who has died \q or mourn for him. \q Instead, cry hard for the king who is being taken away, \q because he will never come back \q to see his homeland again.

es.L: No {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}} por el muerto, \q ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} duelo por él; \q {{plural_you:lloren|llorad}} amargamente por el que se va, \q porque no volverá más \q ni verá la tierra donde nació.
es.B: No {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}} por el que ha muerto; \q no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} duelo por él. \q {{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}} sin cesar por el que se va, \q porque nunca volverá \q ni verá otra vez su tierra natal.
es.R: No {{plural_you:lloren|lloréis}} por el rey que murió \q ni {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} duelo por él. \q {{plural_you:Lloren|Llorad}}, más bien, con todas sus fuerzas por el rey que se llevan, \q porque nunca volverá \q a ver su tierra.

fr.L: Ne pleurez pas sur le mort, \q et ne vous lamentez pas sur lui ; \q pleurez, pleurez sur celui qui s’en va, \q car il ne reviendra plus \q et ne reverra pas le pays de sa naissance.
fr.B: Ne pleurez pas sur celui qui est mort ; \q ne vous lamentez pas sur lui. \q Pleurez, pleurez sans fin sur celui qui s’en va, \q car il ne reviendra jamais \q et ne reverra plus son pays natal.
fr.R: Ne pleurez pas sur le roi qui est mort \q et ne portez pas son deuil. \q Pleurez plutôt de tout votre cœur sur le roi qu’on emmène, \q car il ne reviendra jamais \q revoir son pays.

sw.L: Msimlilie aliyekufa, \q wala msimwombolezee; \q mlilieni sana yeye aendaye zake, \q kwa maana hatarudi tena \q kuiona nchi aliyozaliwa.
sw.B: Msimlilie yeye aliyekufa; \q msimwombolezee. \q Lieni, endeleeni kulia kwa ajili ya yule anayeondoka, \q kwa sababu hatarudi kamwe \q wala kuiona tena nchi yake ya asili.
sw.R: Msimlilie mfalme aliyekufa \q wala msimwombolezee. \q Badala yake, mlilieni kwa uchungu mfalme anayechukuliwa, \q kwa sababu hatarudi kamwe \q kuiona tena nchi yake.

vi.L: Đừng khóc người đã chết, \q cũng đừng than tiếc người; \q hãy khóc lóc thảm thiết cho người ra đi, \q vì người sẽ không trở về nữa \q để thấy quê hương mình.
vi.B: Đừng khóc cho người đã chết; \q đừng than khóc người. \q Hãy khóc, khóc mãi cho người đang ra đi, \q vì người sẽ chẳng bao giờ trở về \q hay thấy lại quê hương mình.
vi.R: Đừng khóc cho vị vua đã chết, \q cũng đừng than tiếc ông. \q Nhưng hãy khóc thật nhiều cho vị vua đang bị bắt đi, \q vì ông sẽ không bao giờ trở về \q để thấy lại quê hương mình.

decisions.choice: the dead: King Josiah; the one going away: his son Shallum, taken to Egypt
decisions.reason: Josiah was killed at Megiddo by Pharaoh Neco in 609 BC and was deeply mourned (2 Kings 23:29-30; 2 Chronicles 35:24-25). Three months later Neco removed his son and successor and took him to Egypt (2 Kings 23:31-34). Verse 11 names him. The fate of the living exile is worse than the death of the good king.

decisions.choice: weep weeping: weep bitterly, without stopping
decisions.reason: The verb is doubled for emphasis, the opposite of the two commands not to weep that come before it.

decisions.choice: show grief: shake the head or rock the body in sympathy, as mourners did
decisions.reason: The verb means to move to and fro; it is used for nodding or shaking the head in grief and comfort (15:5; 16:5; Job 2:11).

decisions.choice: the king who has died; the king who is being taken away
decisions.reason: Readable names both as kings, which verses 11-12 make clear; it does not name them in the verse itself.

source.text: כִּ֣י כֹ֣ה אָֽמַר־יְ֠הוָה אֶל־שַׁלֻּ֨ם בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֜הוּ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֗ה הַמֹּלֵךְ֙ תַּ֚חַת יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ אָבִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֥ר יָצָ֖א מִן־הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה לֹֽא־יָשׁ֥וּב שָׁ֖ם עֽוֹד׃

records.literal_gloss: For thus says Yahweh to Shallum son of Josiah king of Judah, the [one] reigning in place of Josiah his father, who went out from the place this: Not he will return there again.

en.L: For thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who reigned in place of Josiah his father, who went out from this place: He will not return here again.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about Shallum son of Josiah, king of Judah, who became king in place of his father Josiah and has gone away from this place: He will never come back here.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about Shallum son of Josiah, who became king of Judah after his father Josiah and has been taken away from this place: He will never come back here.

es.L: Porque así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Salum hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, que reinó en lugar de Josías su padre, que salió de este lugar: No volverá más aquí.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de Salum hijo de Josías, rey de Judá, que llegó a ser rey en lugar de su padre Josías y que ha salido de este lugar: Nunca volverá aquí.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Salum hijo de Josías, que llegó a ser rey de Judá después de su padre Josías y que fue llevado lejos de este lugar: Nunca volverá aquí.

fr.L: Car ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Shalloum fils de Josias, roi de Juda, qui a régné à la place de Josias son père, et qui est sorti de ce lieu : Il n’y reviendra plus.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet de Shalloum fils de Josias, roi de Juda, qui est devenu roi à la place de son père Josias et qui a quitté ce lieu : Il n’y reviendra jamais.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Shalloum, fils de Josias, qui est devenu roi de Juda après son père Josias et qu’on a emmené loin de ce lieu : Il n’y reviendra jamais.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu Shalumu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, aliyetawala mahali pa Yosia baba yake, aliyetoka mahali hapa: Hatarudi huku tena.
sw.B: Kwa maana hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu Shalumu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda, aliyekuwa mfalme mahali pa baba yake Yosia na ameondoka mahali hapa: Hatarudi huku kamwe.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu Shalumu mwana wa Yosia, aliyekuwa mfalme wa Yuda baada ya baba yake Yosia, na amechukuliwa kutoka mahali hapa: Hatarudi huku kamwe.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về Sa-lum con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, người đã trị vì thay cho Giô-si-a cha mình, là người đã ra đi khỏi nơi này: Nó sẽ không trở về đây nữa.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về Sa-lum con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa, người đã lên ngôi thay cha mình là Giô-si-a và đã ra đi khỏi nơi này: Nó sẽ chẳng bao giờ trở về đây nữa.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về Sa-lum con trai Giô-si-a, người lên làm vua Giu-đa sau cha mình là Giô-si-a và đã bị bắt đi khỏi nơi này: Nó sẽ không bao giờ trở về đây nữa.

decisions.choice: Shallum son of Josiah: the king called Jehoahaz in 2 Kings 23:30-34
decisions.reason: Shallum is listed as a son of Josiah in 1 Chronicles 3:15. The king who reigned three months after Josiah and was taken to Egypt is called Jehoahaz in 2 Kings 23:30-34 and 2 Chronicles 36:1-4; Shallum was probably his personal name and Jehoahaz the name he took as king. Each passage keeps the name its Hebrew uses.

decisions.choice: to Shallum: about Shallum
decisions.reason: The preposition can mean "to" or "concerning"; Shallum is spoken of, not spoken to, so it means "concerning" here, as in verse 18.

decisions.choice: went out: was taken away as a prisoner
decisions.reason: He did not leave by choice; Neco took him away (2 Kings 23:33-34). Verse 12 says he was taken into exile.

decisions.choice: has been taken away
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly that he was forced to go.

decisions.choice: Salum
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here names the king Shallum, so every level keeps "Salum" (published in 1 Chronicles 3:15); 2 Kings 23:30-34 calls him Joacaz (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: Shalumu
decisions.reason: The verse's own name for the king called Yehoahazi in 2 Kings 23:30-34, in the Swahili form of the Kings note; meaning decision m1 says who he is.

decisions.choice: "Shalloum"
decisions.reason: As the Kings note: the verse keeps the name its Hebrew uses, the king called Jehoahaz (Joachaz) in 2 Kings 23:30-34; the meaning decision says they are the same man.

decisions.choice: "Sa-lum"
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the name its Hebrew uses, in the published form "Sa-lum"; meaning decision m1 says that he is the king called Jehoahaz ("Giô-a-cha") in 2 Kings 23:30-34.

source.text: כִּ֗י בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־הִגְל֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ שָׁ֣ם יָמ֑וּת וְאֶת־הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּ֖את לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֥ה עֽוֹד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For in [the] place where they exiled him, there he will die, and the land this not he will see again.

en.L: For in the place where they have exiled him, there he will die, and this land he will not see again.
en.B: He will die in the place where they have taken him as a captive, and he will never see this land again.
en.R: He will die in the country where they took him as a prisoner. He will never see this land again.

es.L: Porque en el lugar adonde lo llevaron cautivo, allí morirá, y no verá más esta tierra.
es.B: Morirá en el lugar adonde lo llevaron cautivo, y nunca más verá esta tierra.
es.R: Morirá en el país adonde lo llevaron preso. Nunca más verá esta tierra.

fr.L: Car c’est dans le lieu où on l’a déporté qu’il mourra, et ce pays, il ne le reverra plus.
fr.B: Il mourra dans le lieu où on l’a emmené captif, et il ne reverra jamais ce pays.
fr.R: Il mourra dans le pays où on l’a emmené comme prisonnier. Il ne reverra jamais ce pays-ci.

sw.L: Kwa maana mahali walipomchukua mateka, huko atafia, wala nchi hii hataiona tena.
sw.B: Atafia mahali walipomchukua mateka, wala hataiona tena nchi hii kamwe.
sw.R: Atafia katika nchi walikompeleka kama mfungwa. Hataiona tena nchi hii kamwe.

vi.L: Vì nó sẽ chết tại nơi người ta đã đày nó đến, và nó sẽ không thấy lại xứ này nữa.
vi.B: Nó sẽ chết tại nơi người ta đã bắt nó đến làm tù binh, và sẽ chẳng bao giờ thấy lại xứ này.
vi.R: Nó sẽ chết tại xứ người ta đã bắt nó đến làm tù binh. Nó sẽ không bao giờ thấy lại xứ này nữa.

decisions.choice: the place where they exiled him: Egypt, where Jehoahaz died
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 23:34 records that he went to Egypt and died there, as this word says.

decisions.choice: no "for" at the start (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The opening word here marks a contrast with "he will not return" ("but", "instead"); Balanced and Readable leave it unspoken and let the sentences follow one another.

source.text: ה֣וֹי בֹּנֶ֤ה בֵיתוֹ֙ בְּֽלֹא־צֶ֔דֶק וַעֲלִיּוֹתָ֖יו בְּלֹ֣א מִשְׁפָּ֑ט בְּרֵעֵ֨הוּ֙ יַעֲבֹ֣ד חִנָּ֔ם וּפֹעֲל֖וֹ לֹ֥א יִתֶּן־לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Woe, [the one] building his house by not righteousness and his upper rooms by not justice; by his neighbor he works for nothing, and his wages not he gives to him.

en.L: Woe, he who builds his house without righteousness \q and his upper rooms without justice, \q who makes his neighbor work for nothing \q and does not give him his wages,
en.B: Woe to the man who builds his palace without righteousness \q and his upper rooms without justice, \q who makes his fellow citizens work for nothing \q and does not pay them their wages.
en.R: How terrible it will be for the king who builds his palace by doing wrong \q and adds rooms upstairs by cheating people. \q He makes his own people work for nothing \q and does not pay them for their work.

es.L: ¡Ay del que edifica su casa sin justicia \q y sus aposentos altos sin derecho, \q que hace trabajar de balde a su prójimo \q y no le da su salario!
es.B: ¡Ay del que construye su palacio sin justicia \q y sus habitaciones altas sin derecho, \q que hace trabajar gratis a sus compatriotas \q y no les paga su salario!
es.R: ¡Qué terrible será para el rey que construye su palacio haciendo lo malo \q y agrega habitaciones arriba engañando a la gente! \q Hace trabajar gratis a su propio pueblo \q y no les paga por su trabajo.

fr.L: Malheur, celui qui bâtit sa maison sans la justice \q et ses chambres hautes sans le droit, \q qui fait travailler son prochain pour rien \q et ne lui donne pas son salaire,
fr.B: Malheur à celui qui bâtit son palais sans justice \q et ses chambres hautes sans droit, \q qui fait travailler ses compatriotes pour rien \q et ne leur paie pas leur salaire.
fr.R: Quel malheur pour le roi qui construit son palais en faisant le mal \q et qui ajoute des chambres à l’étage en trompant les gens ! \q Il fait travailler son propre peuple pour rien \q et il ne le paie pas pour son travail.

sw.L: Ole, yeye aijengaye nyumba yake pasipo haki, \q na vyumba vyake vya juu pasipo hukumu, \q amtumikishaye jirani yake bure, \q wala hampi ujira wake,
sw.B: Ole wake yeye ajengaye jumba lake bila haki, \q na vyumba vyake vya juu bila hukumu ya haki, \q awafanyishaye kazi wenzake bure \q wala hawalipi mishahara yao.
sw.R: Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa mfalme anayejenga jumba lake kwa kutenda maovu, \q na kuongeza vyumba vya juu kwa kuwadanganya watu. \q Anawafanyisha watu wake kazi bure \q wala hawalipi kwa kazi yao.

vi.L: Khốn cho kẻ xây nhà mình không bằng sự công chính, \q và lầu gác mình không bằng công lý, \q bắt người lân cận làm việc không công \q mà không trả tiền công cho họ,
vi.B: Khốn cho kẻ xây cung điện mình bằng sự bất chính \q và lầu gác mình bằng sự bất công, \q bắt đồng bào mình làm việc không công \q mà chẳng trả tiền công cho họ.
vi.R: Thật khốn khổ cho vị vua xây cung điện mình bằng việc làm sai trái \q và xây thêm phòng trên lầu bằng cách lừa gạt người ta. \q Vua bắt chính dân mình làm việc không công \q và không trả tiền cho công việc của họ.

decisions.choice: the builder: King Jehoiakim, Josiah's son, named in verse 18
decisions.reason: After Neco removed Jehoahaz, he made his brother Eliakim king and renamed him Jehoiakim (2 Kings 23:34-35). Jehoiakim paid Egypt heavy tribute taxed from the people, and this oracle charges him with building himself a new palace with forced, unpaid labor.

decisions.choice: by his neighbor he works for nothing: he makes his fellow Israelites work for him without pay
decisions.reason: "Neighbor" is a fellow member of the people. The Law forbids holding back a worker's wages even overnight (Leviticus 19:13; Deuteronomy 24:14-15), and Samuel had warned that kings would put the people to work for themselves (1 Samuel 8:11-17).

decisions.choice: without righteousness, without justice: by wrongdoing, not merely without virtue
decisions.reason: "By not-righteousness" means by unjust means: the house is built out of wrongs done to others, the very opposite of the command in verse 3.

decisions.choice: Woe, ... (L); Woe to ... (B); How terrible it will be for ... (R)
decisions.reason: The wording set for this cry in Isaiah, used for Jeremiah as well.

decisions.choice: by doing wrong; by cheating people
decisions.reason: Readable says what "without righteousness" and "without justice" mean here.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay del que ...! (Literal, Balanced); ¡Qué terrible será para ...! (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Spanish wording of *hoy* when it threatens, kept through the block, as the terms note sets (Matthew 23:13).

decisions.choice: Ole, ... (Literal); Ole wake ... (Balanced); Itakuwa vibaya sana kwa ... (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for *hoy* when it threatens, as Luke 6:24; Balanced uses "wake" because one man is meant.

decisions.choice: "Malheur, celui qui" (L); "Malheur à celui qui" (B); "Quel malheur pour le roi qui ... !" (R)
decisions.reason: The French wording of hoy that the terms note sets when it threatens, as Matthew 23:13 at Readable.

decisions.choice: "Khốn cho" (L, B); "Thật khốn khổ cho" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for "hoy" as a threat; "Than ôi" is kept for the funeral cry of verse 18.

source.text: הָאֹמֵ֗ר אֶבְנֶה־לִּי֙ בֵּ֣ית מִדּ֔וֹת וַעֲלִיּ֖וֹת מְרֻוָּחִ֑ים וְקָ֤רַֽע לוֹ֙ חַלּוֹנָ֔י וְסָפ֣וּן בָּאָ֔רֶז וּמָשׁ֖וֹחַ בַּשָּׁשַֽׁר׃

records.literal_gloss: The [one] saying: I will build for myself a house of dimensions and upper rooms spacious; and he cuts out for himself my windows, and [it is] paneled with cedar and painting with vermilion.

en.L: who says, "I will build myself a house of [great] size, \q and spacious upper rooms," \q and cuts out windows for it, \q paneling [it] with cedar and painting [it] with vermilion.
en.B: He says, "I will build myself a huge palace \q with spacious upper rooms." \q He cuts windows into it, \q panels it with cedar and paints it with vermilion.
en.R: He says, "I will build myself a huge palace \q with large rooms upstairs." \q He puts in windows, \q covers the walls with cedar and paints them bright red.

es.L: que dice: «Me edificaré una casa de [grandes] dimensiones \q y aposentos altos espaciosos», \q y le abre ventanas, \q y [la] reviste de cedro y [la] pinta de bermellón.
es.B: Dice: «Me construiré un palacio enorme \q con amplias habitaciones arriba». \q Le abre ventanas, \q la reviste de cedro y la pinta de bermellón.
es.R: Dice: «Me construiré un palacio enorme \q con habitaciones grandes en el piso de arriba». \q Le pone ventanas, \q cubre las paredes con cedro y las pinta de rojo vivo.

fr.L: qui dit : « Je me bâtirai une maison de [grandes] dimensions, \q et des chambres hautes spacieuses », \q et qui y perce des fenêtres, \q la lambrissant de cèdre et la peignant de vermillon.
fr.B: Il dit : « Je me bâtirai un immense palais \q avec des chambres hautes spacieuses. » \q Il y perce des fenêtres, \q la lambrisse de cèdre et la peint de vermillon.
fr.R: Il dit : « Je vais me construire un immense palais \q avec de grandes chambres à l’étage. » \q Il fait percer des fenêtres, \q couvre les murs de cèdre et les peint en rouge vif.

sw.L: asemaye, "Nitajijengea nyumba ya [ukubwa] wa vipimo, \q na vyumba vya juu vyenye nafasi," \q na kujikatia madirisha, \q [akiipamba] kwa mierezi na kuipaka rangi nyekundu.
sw.B: Anasema, "Nitajijengea jumba kubwa sana \q lenye vyumba vya juu vyenye nafasi." \q Analitobolea madirisha, \q analipamba kwa mbao za mwerezi na kulipaka rangi nyekundu.
sw.R: Anasema, "Nitajijengea jumba kubwa sana \q lenye vyumba vikubwa ghorofani." \q Anaweka madirisha, \q anazifunika kuta kwa mbao za mwerezi na kuzipaka rangi nyekundu sana.

vi.L: kẻ nói: "Ta sẽ xây cho mình một tòa nhà [rộng] lớn, \q với lầu gác rộng rãi," \q rồi trổ cửa sổ cho nó, \q lót [nó] bằng gỗ bá hương và sơn [nó] màu son đỏ.
vi.B: Hắn nói: "Ta sẽ xây cho mình một cung điện đồ sộ \q với những lầu gác rộng rãi." \q Hắn trổ cửa sổ cho cung điện, \q ốp gỗ bá hương và sơn màu son đỏ.
vi.R: Vua ấy nói: "Ta sẽ xây cho mình một cung điện thật lớn \q với những phòng rộng trên lầu." \q Vua cho làm cửa sổ, \q ốp tường bằng gỗ bá hương và sơn màu đỏ tươi.

decisions.choice: windows for it: the ending of the word read as part of the plural, not as "my"
decisions.reason: As written, the word looks like "my windows". That would make the king still speaking, which fits poorly after "he cuts out". The ending is probably a form of the plural, or a slip for "his windows"; either way the sense is that he cuts windows in the house.

decisions.choice: cedar and vermilion: costly cedar paneling and bright red paint
decisions.reason: Cedar was imported from Lebanon and used in palaces and the temple (1 Kings 6:9; 7:2-3). Vermilion was a red pigment, a luxury colour (Ezekiel 23:14).

decisions.choice: a house of dimensions, spacious upper rooms: a large palace with airy rooms on the upper floor
decisions.reason: "A house of measures" means one of great size; "spacious" describes rooms open to the air, the cool upper rooms of a fine house.

decisions.choice: bright red (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable names the colour instead of the pigment.

decisions.choice: the king says "ta" of himself
decisions.reason: A king speaking of himself says "ta", as the terms note gives for the kings in Kings; it is not God's "Ta" and takes no span, though here it opens the quotation and so has a capital.

source.text: הֲתִֽמְלֹ֔ךְ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה מְתַחֲרֶ֣ה בָאָ֑רֶז אָבִ֜יךָ הֲל֧וֹא אָכַ֣ל וְשָׁתָ֗ה וְעָשָׂ֤ה מִשְׁפָּט֙ וּצְדָקָ֔ה אָ֖ז ט֥וֹב לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Will you reign because you [are] competing in cedar? Your father, did not he eat and drink and do justice and righteousness? Then [it was] good for him.

en.L: Do you reign because you compete in cedar? \q Your father, did he not eat and drink \q and do justice and righteousness? \q Then [it was] well with him.
en.B: Does it make you a king to outdo others in cedar? \q Did not your father eat and drink \q and also do justice and righteousness? \q Then all went well with him.
en.R: Does having more cedar than anyone else make you a real king? \q Your father had food and drink, \q and he did what was fair and right, \q and so things went well for him.

es.L: ¿Reinarás porque compites en cedro? \q Tu padre, ¿no comía y bebía \q y hacía derecho y justicia? \q Entonces le iba bien.
es.B: ¿Te hace rey el superar a otros en cedro? \q ¿No comía y bebía tu padre, \q y también practicaba el derecho y la justicia? \q Entonces todo le iba bien.
es.R: ¿Acaso tener más cedro que nadie te hace un verdadero rey? \q Tu padre tenía comida y bebida, \q y hacía lo que era justo y correcto, \q y por eso le fue bien.

fr.L: Règnes-tu parce que tu rivalises de cèdre ? \q Ton père, ne mangeait-il pas et ne buvait-il pas, \q et ne pratiquait-il pas le droit et la justice ? \q Alors [tout allait] bien pour lui.
fr.B: Est-ce que rivaliser de cèdre fait de toi un roi ? \q Ton père ne mangeait-il pas et ne buvait-il pas, \q tout en pratiquant le droit et la justice ? \q Alors tout allait bien pour lui.
fr.R: Est-ce qu’avoir plus de cèdre que tout le monde fait de toi un vrai roi ? \q Ton père avait à manger et à boire, \q et il faisait ce qui est juste et honnête, \q et donc tout allait bien pour lui.

sw.L: Je, utatawala kwa sababu unashindana kwa mierezi? \q Baba yako, je, hakula na kunywa \q na kutenda hukumu na haki? \q Ndipo [ikawa] heri kwake.
sw.B: Je, kushindana na wengine kwa mierezi kunakufanya uwe mfalme? \q Je, baba yako hakula na kunywa, \q tena akatenda haki na uadilifu? \q Ndipo mambo yote yakamwendea vema.
sw.R: Je, kuwa na mierezi mingi kuliko wengine kunakufanya uwe mfalme wa kweli? \q Baba yako alikuwa na chakula na kinywaji, \q naye alitenda yaliyo ya haki na mema, \q kwa hiyo mambo yalimwendea vema.

vi.L: Có phải ngươi làm vua vì ngươi đua tranh bằng gỗ bá hương sao? \q Cha ngươi, chẳng phải người đã ăn và uống \q và thi hành công lý và sự công chính sao? \q Bấy giờ [mọi sự] tốt đẹp cho người.
vi.B: Phải chăng ngươi là vua vì ngươi muốn hơn người khác bằng gỗ bá hương? \q Cha ngươi chẳng phải cũng đã ăn uống, \q mà vẫn thi hành công lý và sự công chính sao? \q Bấy giờ mọi sự đều tốt đẹp cho người.
vi.R: Có nhiều gỗ bá hương hơn mọi người khác có làm cho ngươi thành một vị vua thật sự không? \q Cha ngươi cũng có đủ thức ăn thức uống, \q và người đã làm điều công bằng và ngay thẳng. \q Vì vậy mọi việc đều tốt đẹp cho người.

decisions.choice: will you reign because you compete in cedar: does trying to outdo others in grand cedar buildings make a man a king?
decisions.reason: The verb "compete" is the one used in 12:5 for racing against horses. The question mocks a king who thinks splendor proves his kingship.

decisions.choice: your father ate and drank and did justice: Josiah enjoyed an ordinary, full life and still ruled justly, and that is what made him a true king
alternatives: he was content with plain food and drink, not luxury
decisions.reason: "Eat and drink" means living well and in peace (1 Kings 4:20). Josiah had what a king needs and did not need palaces built by injustice; his kingship showed in his justice. Some take the words to mean that he was content with simple food and drink instead of luxury; either way the stress falls on the justice he did.

decisions.choice: then it was good for him: because of his justice, things went well for him
decisions.reason: The words echo the Law's promise that it will go well for those who do what is right (Deuteronomy 6:18; 12:28). The same phrase returns in verse 16.

decisions.choice: the question about Josiah becomes a statement (Readable)
decisions.reason: The question expects the answer "yes"; Readable gives the answer as a statement.

decisions.choice: what was fair and right
decisions.reason: As in verse 3.

decisions.choice: God says "ngươi" to Jehoiakim; his father Josiah is "người"
decisions.reason: The king under judgment is addressed as "ngươi" at every level, like the palace in verse 6; the honoured Josiah is spoken of as "người", the respectful third-person pronoun of poetry.

source.text: דָּ֛ן דִּין־עָנִ֥י וְאֶבְי֖וֹן אָ֣ז ט֑וֹב הֲלוֹא־הִ֛יא הַדַּ֥עַת אֹתִ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: He judged [the] cause of [the] poor and needy; then [it was] good. Not [is] that the knowing me? declares Yahweh.

en.L: He judged the cause of the poor and needy; then [it was] well. \q Is not that what it is to know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He defended the cause of the poor and the needy, and then all was well. \q Is that not what it means to know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}? declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He stood up for the rights of poor people and those in need, and everything went well. \q That is what it means to know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Juzgaba la causa del pobre y del necesitado; entonces [le iba] bien. \q ¿No es eso conocerme?, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Defendía la causa del pobre y del necesitado, y entonces todo iba bien. \q ¿No es eso lo que significa conocerme?, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Defendía los derechos de los pobres y de los necesitados, y todo le iba bien. \q Eso es lo que significa conocerme, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Il jugeait la cause du pauvre et du malheureux ; alors [tout allait] bien. \q N’est-ce pas cela, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il défendait la cause du pauvre et du malheureux, et alors tout allait bien. \q N’est-ce pas cela, {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître ? déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il défendait les droits des pauvres et des gens dans le besoin, et tout allait bien. \q Voilà ce que c’est que de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaître, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Aliamua shauri la maskini na mhitaji; ndipo [ikawa] heri. \q Je, si huko ndiko kunijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Aliitetea haki ya maskini na mhitaji, ndipo mambo yote yakawa mema. \q Je, si hiyo ndiyo maana ya kunijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}? asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Aliwatetea maskini na wahitaji wapate haki zao, na kila kitu kikaenda vema. \q Hiyo ndiyo maana ya kunijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Người đã xét xử duyên cớ của người nghèo và người thiếu thốn; bấy giờ [mọi sự] tốt đẹp. \q Đó chẳng phải là biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Người đã bênh vực quyền lợi của người nghèo và người thiếu thốn, và bấy giờ mọi sự đều tốt đẹp. \q Đó chẳng phải là biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Người đã bênh vực quyền lợi của người nghèo và người túng thiếu, và mọi việc đều tốt đẹp. \q Biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là như thế đó, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

decisions.choice: judged the cause of the poor and needy: took up their case and saw that they received justice
decisions.reason: To "judge the cause" of someone is to hear their case and decide for them in court; for the poor, who had no one else to plead for them, it meant defending them (5:28; Psalm 72:2-4).

decisions.choice: is not that to know me: to know the LORD is to do justice for the weak, not only to know about him
alternatives: knowing God leads to doing justice (the second is the fruit of the first)
decisions.reason: In Jeremiah, knowing God is a relationship that shows in conduct (9:23; 31:34). Josiah's care for the poor was itself knowledge of God, because it is what God himself does and delights in. Knowing God and doing justice are not two things set side by side here; the one is the form of the other (Hosea 4:1-2; 6:6).

decisions.choice: the question becomes a statement (Readable)
decisions.reason: The question expects "yes", so Readable states the answer.

source.text: כִּ֣י אֵ֤ין עֵינֶ֨יךָ֙ וְלִבְּךָ֔ כִּ֖י אִם־עַל־בִּצְעֶ֑ךָ וְעַ֤ל דַּֽם־הַנָּקִי֙ לִשְׁפּ֔וֹךְ וְעַל־הָעֹ֥שֶׁק וְעַל־הַמְּרוּצָ֖ה לַעֲשֽׂוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For not [are] your eyes and your heart except on your gain, and on the blood of the innocent to shed [it], and on the oppression and on the extortion to do [them].

en.L: But your eyes and your heart are on nothing \q except your unjust gain, \q and on shedding the blood of the innocent, \q and on doing oppression and extortion.
en.B: But your eyes and your heart are set on nothing \q but dishonest gain, \q on shedding innocent blood, \q and on practicing oppression and extortion.
en.R: But all you care about is getting rich by cheating, \q killing innocent people, \q and crushing people and taking what is theirs.

es.L: Pero tus ojos y tu corazón no están \q sino en tu ganancia injusta, \q y en derramar la sangre del inocente, \q y en hacer opresión y extorsión.
es.B: Pero tus ojos y tu corazón no buscan \q más que ganancias deshonestas, \q derramar sangre inocente \q y practicar la opresión y la extorsión.
es.R: Pero lo único que te importa es enriquecerte haciendo trampa, \q matar a gente inocente, \q y aplastar a la gente y quitarle lo que es suyo.

fr.L: Mais tes yeux et ton cœur ne sont à rien \q sinon à ton profit, \q et à verser le sang de l’innocent, \q et à pratiquer l’oppression et l’extorsion.
fr.B: Mais tes yeux et ton cœur ne cherchent rien d’autre \q que le gain malhonnête, \q le sang innocent à verser, \q l’oppression et l’extorsion à pratiquer.
fr.R: Mais tout ce qui t’intéresse, c’est de t’enrichir en trichant, \q de tuer des innocents, \q d’écraser les gens et de leur prendre ce qui leur appartient.

sw.L: Lakini macho yako na moyo wako haviko juu ya kitu \q ila faida yako ya udhalimu, \q na kumwaga damu ya wasio na hatia, \q na kutenda dhuluma na unyang'anyi.
sw.B: Lakini macho yako na moyo wako havijaelekezwa kwa kitu kingine \q ila faida isiyo ya haki, \q kumwaga damu isiyo na hatia, \q na kutenda dhuluma na unyang'anyi.
sw.R: Lakini unachojali tu ni kutajirika kwa kudanganya, \q kuwaua watu wasio na hatia, \q na kuwakandamiza watu na kunyang'anya mali zao.

vi.L: Nhưng mắt ngươi và lòng ngươi chẳng chú vào điều gì \q ngoại trừ lợi bất chính của ngươi, \q và làm đổ máu người vô tội, \q và làm sự áp bức và bóc lột.
vi.B: Nhưng mắt ngươi và lòng ngươi chỉ chăm chăm \q vào lợi lộc bất chính, \q vào việc làm đổ máu vô tội, \q và vào việc áp bức, bóc lột.
vi.R: Nhưng ngươi chỉ lo làm giàu bằng cách gian lận, \q giết người vô tội, \q chà đạp người khác và cướp đoạt những gì thuộc về họ.

decisions.choice: your: Jehoiakim, now spoken to directly
decisions.reason: Verses 13-16 spoke about the builder and to him; here the king is addressed and contrasted with his father. Verse 18 names him.

decisions.choice: your gain: profit gained by violence or fraud
decisions.reason: The word means gain cut off unfairly, ill-gotten profit (6:13; 8:10).

decisions.choice: shedding innocent blood: putting to death those who had done nothing worthy of death
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 26:20-23 tells how Jehoiakim had the prophet Uriah hunted down in Egypt and killed. Compare verse 3.

decisions.choice: crushing people and taking what is theirs
decisions.reason: Readable explains "oppression and extortion" in plain words.

source.text: לָכֵ֞ן כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־יְהוֹיָקִ֤ים בֶּן־יֹאשִׁיָּ֨הוּ֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה לֹא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔וֹ ה֥וֹי אָחִ֖י וְה֣וֹי אָח֑וֹת לֹא־יִסְפְּד֣וּ ל֔וֹ ה֥וֹי אָד֖וֹן וְה֥וֹי הֹדֹֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Therefore thus says Yahweh concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah king of Judah: Not they will lament for him: Alas, my brother, and alas, sister! Not they will lament for him: Alas, lord, and alas, his majesty!

en.L: Therefore thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: \q They will not lament for him, \q "Alas, my brother!" or "Alas, sister!" \q They will not lament for him, \q "Alas, lord!" or "Alas, his majesty!"
en.B: Therefore {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says this about Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: \q No one will mourn for him, crying, \q "Alas, my brother! Alas, my sister!" \q No one will mourn for him, crying, \q "Alas, my master! Alas, his majesty!"
en.R: So this is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says about Jehoiakim son of Josiah, king of Judah: \q No one will cry at his funeral, \q "How sad, my brother! How sad, my sister!" \q No one will weep for him and say, \q "How sad, our master! How sad for our great king!"

es.L: Por tanto, así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá: \q No harán duelo por él: \q «¡Ay, hermano mío!», «¡Ay, hermana!». \q No harán duelo por él: \q «¡Ay, señor!», «¡Ay, su majestad!».
es.B: Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá: \q Nadie hará duelo por él diciendo: \q «¡Ay, hermano mío! ¡Ay, hermana mía!». \q Nadie hará duelo por él diciendo: \q «¡Ay, mi señor! ¡Ay, su majestad!».
es.R: Por eso, esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} acerca de Joacim hijo de Josías, rey de Judá: \q Nadie llorará en su entierro: \q «¡Ay, hermano mío! ¡Ay, hermana mía!». \q Nadie llorará por él diciendo: \q «¡Ay, nuestro señor! ¡Ay, nuestro gran rey!».

fr.L: C’est pourquoi ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda : \q On ne se lamentera pas sur lui : \q « Hélas, mon frère ! » ou « Hélas, ma sœur ! » \q On ne se lamentera pas sur lui : \q « Hélas, seigneur ! » ou « Hélas, sa majesté ! »
fr.B: C’est pourquoi {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet de Joïaqim fils de Josias, roi de Juda : \q Personne ne portera son deuil en criant : \q « Hélas, mon frère ! Hélas, ma sœur ! » \q Personne ne portera son deuil en criant : \q « Hélas, mon maître ! Hélas, sa majesté ! »
fr.R: Alors voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au sujet de Joïaqim, fils de Josias, roi de Juda : \q Personne ne criera à ses funérailles : \q « Quelle tristesse, mon frère ! Quelle tristesse, ma sœur ! » \q Personne ne pleurera sur lui en disant : \q « Quelle tristesse, notre maître ! Quelle tristesse pour notre grand roi ! »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda: \q Hawatamwombolezea, \q "Ole, ndugu yangu!" au "Ole, dada!" \q Hawatamwombolezea, \q "Ole, bwana!" au "Ole, utukufu wake!"
sw.B: Kwa hiyo hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda: \q Hakuna atakayemwombolezea akilia, \q "Ole, ndugu yangu! Ole, dada yangu!" \q Hakuna atakayemwombolezea akilia, \q "Ole, bwana wangu! Ole, mtukufu wetu!"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu Yehoyakimu mwana wa Yosia, mfalme wa Yuda: \q Hakuna atakayelia katika mazishi yake, \q "Inasikitisha, ndugu yangu! Inasikitisha, dada yangu!" \q Hakuna atakayemlilia na kusema, \q "Inasikitisha, bwana wetu! Inasikitisha kwa mfalme wetu mkuu!"

vi.L: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa: \q Người ta sẽ không than khóc nó: \q "Than ôi, anh tôi!" hay "Than ôi, chị!" \q Người ta sẽ không than khóc nó: \q "Than ôi, chúa!" hay "Than ôi, bệ hạ!"
vi.B: Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa: \q Sẽ không ai khóc thương nó mà kêu: \q "Than ôi, anh tôi! Than ôi, em tôi!" \q Sẽ không ai khóc thương nó mà kêu: \q "Than ôi, chúa tôi! Than ôi, bệ hạ!"
vi.R: Vì vậy, đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về Giê-hô-gia-kim con trai Giô-si-a, vua Giu-đa: \q Sẽ không ai khóc trong đám tang nó: \q "Thật đáng buồn, anh ơi! Thật đáng buồn, em ơi!" \q Sẽ không ai khóc thương nó mà nói: \q "Thật đáng buồn, chủ chúng tôi ơi! Thật đáng buồn cho vị vua vĩ đại của chúng tôi!"

decisions.choice: alas: the cry of mourners at a funeral
decisions.reason: The same word that begins the woe in verse 13 is here the wail of lament over the dead (1 Kings 13:30). The woe pronounced on Jehoiakim takes the place of the mourning he will not receive.

decisions.choice: my brother, sister, lord, his majesty: the set cries of funeral lament
alternatives: the mourners address one another as brother and sister
decisions.reason: Mourners wailed for the dead by calling out to them, "Alas, my brother!" (1 Kings 13:30), and for a king, "Alas, lord!" (34:5). "Sister" may be the women mourners calling to one another, or part of a fixed pair of cries. Jehoiakim will have none of them.

decisions.choice: Alas (Literal and Balanced); How sad (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced say "Alas", the wording set for this funeral cry in Jeremiah (as in 34:5); Readable uses words a modern mourner might say. Because this is a cry of grief, it is not given the "Woe to" wording of verse 13.

decisions.choice: ¡Ay! at every level
decisions.reason: In a funeral cry *hoy* is "¡Ay, hermano mío!" at every level, as the terms note sets (1 Kings 13:30), where the English Readable says "How sad". Readable keeps the cry but makes the titles plain.

decisions.choice: Ole! (Literal, Balanced); Inasikitisha! (Readable)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili for the funeral cry *hoy*, which mourns rather than threatens (1 Kings 13:30).

decisions.choice: "Hélas" (L, B); "Quelle tristesse" (R)
decisions.reason: The French wording the terms note sets for hoy in a funeral cry (also 34:5), kept apart from "Malheur", which threatens.

decisions.choice: "Than ôi" (L, B); "Thật đáng buồn" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form for "hoy" as a funeral cry (22:18; 34:5), kept apart from the "Khốn cho" of a threat in verse 13.

source.text: קְבוּרַ֥ת חֲמ֖וֹר יִקָּבֵ֑ר סָח֣וֹב וְהַשְׁלֵ֔ךְ מֵהָ֖לְאָה לְשַׁעֲרֵ֥י יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: [The] burial of a donkey he will be buried, being dragged and being thrown out beyond to [the] gates of Jerusalem.

en.L: [With] the burial of a donkey he will be buried, \q dragged off and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
en.B: He will be buried the way a donkey is buried, \q dragged away and thrown out beyond the gates of Jerusalem.
en.R: He will be buried like a dead donkey. \q His body will be dragged away and thrown outside the gates of Jerusalem.

es.L: [Con] sepultura de asno será sepultado, \q arrastrado y echado fuera de las puertas de Jerusalén.
es.B: Lo enterrarán como se entierra a un asno: \q arrastrado y tirado fuera de las puertas de Jerusalén.
es.R: Lo enterrarán como a un burro muerto. \q Arrastrarán su cuerpo y lo tirarán fuera de las puertas de Jerusalén.

fr.L: [De] la sépulture d’un âne il sera enseveli, \q traîné et jeté au-delà des portes de Jérusalem.
fr.B: Il sera enseveli comme on enterre un âne, \q traîné et jeté hors des portes de Jérusalem.
fr.R: Il sera enterré comme un âne mort. \q On traînera son corps et on le jettera hors des portes de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Atazikwa [kwa] maziko ya punda, \q akikokotwa na kutupwa nje ya malango ya Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Atazikwa kama punda azikwavyo, \q akikokotwa na kutupwa nje ya malango ya Yerusalemu.
